A Sly Murder

一桩精心策划的谋杀案 · 191 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A professor was giving a lecture on the significance of punctuation when police interrupted and arrested him on suspicion of murdering his wife, a kindergarten receptionist. They found photos he had deleted from their digital album, showing how happy the couple had once been. But he had grown tired of her wrinkled face and killed her instead of divorcing her because he wanted to avoid the division of their property. Investigators concluded that he had put a poison derived from a kind of seashell in his wife’s food. A similar poison was said to have been used on hunting spears long ago. After eating, she cried out, scratched at her chest, felt dizzy and soon died.

2After an initial examination, the police assumed she had died of heart disease. But systematic laboratory tests showed that the watermelon she had spat onto a messy mat and a quilt contained poison. Regardless of their exhaustion and hunger, the skilful officers used laboratory equipment to identify the substance. Their equipment was primitive and limited, but they obtained an accurate result.

3People applauded the police, and the woman’s family could finally look ahead with relief.

一桩精心策划的谋杀案

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一位教授正在讲标点符号的重要性，警察突然打断了他的讲座，以涉嫌谋杀妻子为由逮捕了他。他妻子在幼儿园做接待员。警方找到一些他从两人的电子相册里删掉的照片，照片显示他们曾经生活得很快乐。可他后来嫌妻子脸上起了皱纹。为了避开离婚时的财产分割，他杀害了她。调查人员查明，教授把一种源自贝壳的毒物掺进了妻子的食物。传说古代猎人曾在长矛上涂过类似的毒物。妻子吃下食物后，大声喊叫，抓挠胸口，觉得头晕，很快就死了。

2初步检查后，警方以为她死于心脏病。后来，系统的化验发现，她吐在脏乱的垫子和被子上的西瓜里含有毒物。尽管又累又饿，经验丰富的警员仍用实验室设备仔细辨认毒物的种类。可用的设备虽然简陋，数量也不多，他们最终还是得出了准确的结果。

3人们为警察鼓掌。这位女士的家人终于松了口气，可以安心面对今后的生活了。
